description: B dissolves in through the old shot's accents first and the new shot's accents land last: a dark shot leaves through its highlights, a light shot through its darks, so the order reads the same in both directions. A quick, soft luminance dissolve with a touch of soft focus and bloom at the cut and a gentle push. Every ghost is gone by 78 %.
name: luma-dissolve
title: Luma Dissolve
